camel_example: aliyun iot DeleteDevice --region cn-hangzhou --IotId MpEKNuEUJzIORNANAWJX001092990000000 --IotInstanceId 'iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000' --ProductKey a1FlqIQ0000 --DeviceName light
description_en: Deletes a device. You can also call this operation to delete the topological relationships between a gateway and the sub-devices that are connected to the gateway
description_zh: Deletes a device. You can also call this operation to delete the topological relationships between a gateway and the sub-devices that are connected to the gateway
kebab_example: aliyun iot delete-device --iot-instance-id iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000 --product-key a1FlqIQ0000 --device-name light --iot-id MpEKNuEUJzIORNANAWJX001092990000000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteDevice

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If this value exists, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or the ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device that you want to delete belongs.

<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要删除的设备所属的产品ProductKey。

<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The name of the device that you want to delete.

<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
指定要删除的设备的名称。

<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the device that you want to delete.

<notice> IotId is a globally unique identifier of the device and corresponds to a combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. If you specify IotId together with ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要删除的设备ID。

<notice> IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id
